blocks.content: Let's take a moment to review what you've learned so far.

Imagine you're part of the student registration team at a university, tasked with analyzing elective course enrollments. Your analysis helps identify popular courses, ensuring efficient use of university resources.
In the Available Tables section, you will find two tables:

items: Courses: This table lists all the courses the university provides, including elective courses.
Enrollments: This table records the enrollments of students in various courses.

blocks.content: As a data analyst, the team asks you: "How can you identify which elective courses have enrollments?"
Let's explore how to answer this on the next page.
